content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Incomplete secondary endpoint sentence",
      "quote": "The secondary endpoints are as follows:\nassessed by the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse\nEvents Version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0)\nof documented PD, based on RECIST v1.1",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The secondary endpoints list contains fragments that are not complete sentences, missing the subject and verb (e.g., 'assessed by...' and 'of documented PD...'). This makes the endpoints unclear and uninterpretable.",
      "fix": "Rewrite each secondary endpoint as a complete sentence, e.g., 'Safety and tolerability will be assessed by the National Cancer Institute Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events Version 5.0 (CTCAE v5.0).' and 'Duration of response, defined as time from first response to documented PD, based on RECIST v1.1.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete exploratory objective sentence",
      "quote": "Evaluate the effect of vidutolimod in combination with cemiplimab on injected and",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.1.3 Exploratory Objectives",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The exploratory objective is cut off mid-sentence ('on injected and'), leaving the objective incomplete and unclear.",
      "fix": "Complete the sentence, e.g., 'Evaluate the effect of vidutolimod in combination with cemiplimab on injected and non-injected lesions.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete OS definition",
      "quote": "Overall survival (OS), defined as the time from date of first dose of study treatment to",
      "page": 46,
      "section": "2.2.2 Secondary Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The definition of OS is truncated; it does not specify the event (e.g., death from any cause).",
      "fix": "Complete the definition: 'Overall survival (OS), defined as the time from date of first dose of study treatment to death from any cause.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent dosing schedule description",
      "quote": "Vidutolimod 10 mg will be administered weekly for 7 doses, after which it will be administered Q3W until the subject meets a condition for discontinuation of study treatment.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text says 'weekly for 7 doses' but later states 'The initial 7 vidutolimod doses, administered on a weekly schedule, must be completed before moving on to the Q3W vidutolimod dosing schedule.' This is consistent, but the phrase 'weekly for 7 doses' could be misinterpreted as 7 weeks total; clarify that the 7 doses are given weekly (i.e., over 7 weeks).",
      "fix": "Clarify: 'Vidutolimod 10 mg will be administered weekly for 7 doses (i.e., one dose per week for 7 weeks), after which...'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent imaging interval",
      "quote": "Disease status will be assessed by computed tomography (CT) or magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and other appropriate measures beginning predose at Week 10 Day 1 (W10D1) and will be repeated every 9 weeks (e.g. W19D1, W28D1, etc.)",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text says 'every 9 weeks' but the examples (W19D1, W28D1) are 9 weeks apart from W10D1, which is correct. However, the schema abbreviation list includes 'Q12W = every 12 weeks' which is not mentioned in the text; this may cause confusion about the actual imaging frequency.",
      "fix": "Remove 'Q12W' from the abbreviation list if not used, or clarify if there is a 12-week imaging interval for some cohorts."
    },
    {
      "title": "Unclear post-treatment follow-up frequency",
      "quote": "Subjects who are posttreatment but have not met criteria for study discontinuation should remain on study for posttreatment follow-up (PTFU), which includes disease assessments every 3 months until discontinuation.",
      "page": 49,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text does not specify the duration of PTFU or the criteria for study discontinuation, leaving ambiguity about how long follow-up continues.",
      "fix": "Specify the maximum duration of PTFU (e.g., until 2 years after last dose) and define the criteria for study discontinuation."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent treatment duration statement",
      "quote": "All subjects will receive vidutolimod and cemiplimab according to the treatment schedule up to 2 years or until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 48,
      "section": "3.1 Overall Study Design",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The text says 'up to 2 years' but later states 'At the end of the treatment period (2 years), the Sponsor will not continue to provide supplied study treatment' – this is consistent, but the phrase 'up to 2 years' could be interpreted as a maximum, while the later statement implies a fixed 2-year period. Clarify whether treatment is fixed at 2 years or can stop earlier.",
      "fix": "Clarify: 'All subjects will receive study treatment for a maximum of 2 years, unless a reason for discontinuation occurs earlier.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Incomplete exploratory endpoint sentence",
      "quote": "Baseline and post-treatment changes in tumor CD8 T cell density, activation and/or proliferation status and tumor inflammatory gene expression (including IFN-gamma, Golgi gene expression signature).",
      "page": 47,
      "section": "2.2.3 Exploratory Endpoints",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The exploratory endpoint is a sentence fragment; it lacks a verb and does not specify the outcome measure (e.g., 'will be assessed').",
      "fix": "Rewrite as a complete sentence, e.g., 'Baseline and post-treatment changes in tumor CD8 T cell density, activation and/or proliferation status and tumor inflammatory gene expression (including IFN-gamma, Golgi gene expression signature) will be evaluated.'"
    }
  ]
}
